title: Come, Holy Spirit, Come
description: Come, Holy Spirit, Come in Tonic Solfa to BOYLSTON, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: Joseph Hart wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 258.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to BOYLSTON; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Come, Ho-ly Spir-it, come! Let Thy bright beams a-rise; Dis-pel the sor-row from our minds, The dark-ness from our eyes.

lines: Dispel the sorrow from our minds,
And kindle in our breasts the flame
And to our wondering view reveal
To pour fresh life on every part,
Then shall we know and praise and love

licence: Public domain: Joseph Hart died in 1768.
credits: Words by Joseph Hart (1712–1768), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to BOYLSTON by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
